rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B: "You received a Form 1099-B or Form 1099-DA (or substitute statement) and the basis shown in box 1e on Form 1099-B or box 1g on Form 1099-DA is incorrect"; f8949 p. 1, box G; i1040sd p. 11, line 18 (collectibles). executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 510 partial records from 40 bases; 1,837 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, /tmp/adj-bklg-income/full/, same counts): 1,423 of 1,837 agree; 225 candidate-refuses, 188 candidate-unknown, 1 project-unknown; no value differences. (1) The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes, the source's reading; Boxes G and J (and H, I, K, L) are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (fixture sales.refuse.digital.G passes: Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 refused on sales.digital), so it cannot reach a completed return. (2) All 44 completed-return differences are candidate-refuses on the reply's own consistency check h_basis_bad (box A, D, G or J, no code B, reported basis different from correct basis): classm.u1250.2 and its DeepSeek twin, classm.clcw26.2 (.deepseek), classm.f1040.2, .3 and .6 (and .deepseek), classm.s8812.2.deepseek, classm.f5695.2.deepseek, generated 20, 22, 89 (two sales), 90, 143, 145, 179, 188, 199, 236, 257, 269, 287, 312, 314, 345, 366, 402, 403, 411, 412, 429, 445, 453, 485, and six partials of classm.f1040.2 and classm.s8812.2.deepseek. On such an entry the project reads only the reported basis and the interview never asks sales.correct_basis (checked: classm.f1040.2 sales[s1], box A code none, reported $30,899, correct basis held $0; with correct_basis withheld, column (e) $30,899.00, Form 1040 line 7a $50,930.00 and line 16 $39,507.39 are unchanged). So every witness supplies an answer the interview cannot ask; the source routes an incorrect reported basis through code B, which the interview asks. (3) The other candidate-refuses (h_basis_bad 166, h_aggregate_bad 12, h_other 1, special 2) and the candidate-unknown (special, route, code, aggregate_eligible, reported_basis withheld) are on refused or incomplete records; the project refuses the same entries at sales.one (special, bad_aggregate, bad_code) or needs the same answers at the return: scope. The project-unknown is a partial of stage14.sep.step1_other_se_income withholding correct_basis on a refused return. The fix-round-2 finding F1 (an unanswered sales.special or sales.aggregate_eligible let the return complete) is fixed as BUG-0257: no candidate-unknown witness is now on a completed return (29 in fix round 2). The income package changed only the sales.special wording (PENDING-6: an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust, including S corporation stock, that holds collectibles or section 1250 property), which matches i1040sd p. 11, line 18, "an interest in a partnership, S corporation, or trust ... attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles", and p. 12, line 19; a wider reading can only refuse. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i8949 p. 10, code W: "enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)"; i8949 p. 8, code B. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 510 partial records from 40 bases; 1,837 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, /tmp/adj-bklg-income/full/, same counts): 1,831 of 1,837 agree; the 6 differences are project-unknown on incomplete partial records withholding sales[].box, proceeds or correct_basis (partials of classm.asset.1 sales[s1], candidate $861.00, and classm.sdtw.4 sales[s2], candidate $361.00), answers the interview asks of every sale; the project's column (g) now reads them through its wash-sale check, the candidate's only when it needs them. No completed-return difference. The reply's own refusal h_wash_bad (code W or BW and wash-sale loss above max(0, correct basis less proceeds)) is the project's new gate within the interview: with no code B the interview does not ask the correct basis and the project uses the reported basis, the only basis it has. The income package's gate sales.wash_bad (code W, wash-sale loss above zero, and sales.wash_over = columns (d) less (e) plus the code B correction plus the wash-sale loss above zero) refuses at sales.w when the entered loss is larger than the loss on the sale: i8949 p. 10, code W, "You have a nondeductible loss from a wash sale" and "enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)"; p550 p. 86, "A wash sale occurs when you sell or trade stock or securities at a loss". sales.wash_over is column (h), so the gate refuses exactly when column (h) would exceed zero; a wash-sale loss equal to the loss gives (h) $0 and is accepted (sales.adjust.A.W.equal_loss: (g) $200.00, (h) $0.00, line 7a $0.00, evaluated), and the code B correction counts toward the loss (sales.adjust.D.BW.wash_within_corrected_loss: (g) $500.00, (h) -$500.00, evaluated). It neither refuses an allowable entry nor admits an over-large one; no error introduced. Project stands.
